notes.title: August Production Report
notes.content:
Hello there! 

As promised, here’s some fresh news about ARISEN:
[list][*] As we talked before we are still scouting for partners to port the game on Switch & mobile. [i]Get in touch if you are interested![/i][/list][list]
[*] Meanwhile, we are planning to work on a new patch to improve the game. It should contain: 
[list]
[*] [b]Gamepad compatibility[/b] is on its way: you’ll be able to play from your favorite spot in no time with the Steam Deck. We are assessing if it’s possible to make the game playable onto it[/list][list]
[*] Maybe some [b]new content for ACT3[/b], but just a small teasing.[/list][/list][list]
[*] On a less optimistic note: in order to ensure transparency, we have to share that the 3rd act is still on hold, as we are unfortunately not generating enough revenue to support further development.
[i]Have a peek:[/i] [/list][list][list]
[*] Since we brought the game 1 year ago, we roughly sold more than 1500 units of the games, just enough to refund the invest for the game rights 
[*] But not enough to invest and pay for the third act.[/list][/list]
Rest assured that we still have the best at heart for Arisen. So be sure to share your interest and talk about it in your friends circle, it would help a lot! 
We also believe that releasing the game out of Early Access before the end of the year and porting it  on mobile and / or Switch will add more revenue and give a boost to sell more copies. 

[list][*] On a brighter side: we are participating in the [b]Visual Novel Fest[/b] on Steam from the 7th to the 14th of August, where you can grab our game for the first time at a huge discount : [b]-50%[/b]![/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279200/0279e468e3d03d7f3cef8ff1d08b22067552772e.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1101670/ARISEN__Chronicles_of_VarNagal/

The next months will be dedicated to the release of ARISEN in its final version. We hope with all our hearts that it will generate enough revenue to sustain the ACT3. [b]Keep your fingers crossed, and stay tuned![/b]

notes.title: ARISEN new game update, OST release and ARISEN purchase
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279200/13dbe5e1b5a0a358f553cd281df1d265971817d5.png[/img]

Hello everyone! 

Here’s Ben from Homecoming Studio: You may remember me as I worked with Maratus on the marketing and producing side, from the Kickstarter to the end. 
Today I’m writing on the Homecoming Studio behalf:  We’re happy to share that we have bought back ARISEN since the bankruptcy of Maratus! 
A good way to keep the game in the hands of people that worked on the production. :) 

I’m sure your next question is:[b] What will be the future for ARISEN? [/b]

So far here’s our roadmap: 

[h3]This week: [/h3]
- We will release a new game update! It will contains a few bugfixes that improve stability and the overall game visual experience. It’s the last patch made by the Maratus team. You will find the patch note after. 

- We’re ready to publish the Original Soundtrack composed by Yann Rayon, we will send it to the Kickstarter Backers this week. By the end of the month, the soundractk will be available on other musical streaming platforms. We are also thinking about publishing it on Steam too and we would like to hear from you: do you want it here too? 

- We will also take down the Prologue Version. The purpose was initially to support the Kickstarter campaigns and get a maximum of feedback from our community (you!). But as we have now the demo on our main Steam Page, we want to avoid spreading the traffic, or maintain the content there. 
You will continue to have access to the prologue for free by downloading the demo version on the main page.

[h3]In the next month:[/h3]
Our wish is to releae one way or another the end of ARISEN in the future. That's why our current plan is to retain as much money we can from the sales. At the moment, it is insufficient to cover the development cost for the Act3. Which means the development of Act 3 is officially on hold. 

We are looking for partners or deals to continue the development further and maybe release the game on other platforms than Steam. I'll keep you posted on what happens next! 

We still definitely need your support. So please, do not hesitate to share the game around you and recommend it to your friends, family, colleagues or your favourite streamers!
Also, do not hesitate to leave a positive review on Steam or to wishlist it if you don't already own the game. It will boost our visibility on the store!

Wish you the best, thank you for your support!
Ben.

notes.title: 🎉 HAPPY HOLIDAYS! 🎉
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279200/52d9d84a3907b4a78cd0f6898b9f5d68b503f52e.png[/img]

Hello everyone! ❤️

It's a pleasure to write a new production update as it's been a while! As the end of the year is coming, we'll give you more details about the state of the game.

First, we wanted to thank you once again for your support! We received heartwarming feedback, and seeing more and more players in the game made us proud of our work. ✨

This year, a lot of things happened, bad as well as good, but we’ve succeeded in releasing [b]ARISEN in Early Access[/b]! It’s already been 3 months since the game is available with its first act playable!

[b]But it is not over yet![/b] For 2022, we will do our best to add more content! Here is a list of what we’re planning to do in estimated time!

Before we start, we would like to clarify some points! At first, we planned to release Act 2 sooner. Unfortunately, we had several issues with how the translation works, so we did a complete rework of this system. By doing this way, we knew the integration process would be longer than before. Still, it’s for the better! We will hopefully get rid of French text for English players on next patches. Moreover, fixing issues shall be easier from now on.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279200/9f2692bb239459355bfd750853c624c19242712e.png[/img]

[h2]📜[b] Act 2 part 1: ETA Q1 2022[/b][/h2]

Act 2 has a different narrative structure, going deeper into the relationship with the 6 characters. We plan to release it with two big content releases during the next months, during the first quarter of 2022. As we asked you, we think it’s better to release into 2 parts and give you access earlier to a smaller part of the act than waiting longer for a full big patch of content with the whole act. 

In this first update we want to improve a lot the quality of life in the game in many aspects: 
[list]
[*] The new journal
[*] Fully Gamepad navigation
[*] Twitch play with the chat extension
[*] Night and day cycle
[*] Better sound integration
[*] The prologue of Act 2 and 3 characters’ quests
[/list]

[h2]📜[b] Act 2 part 2 ETA: Q2 2022 [/b][/h2]

This will be the second big patch of content. Except for this time, you will be able to play the full act 2 ending. 
[list]
[*] Various improvements
[*] Act 2 Galerie & achievements update
[*] The 3 remaining characters’ quests and the epilogue of Act 2
[/list]

[h2]📜[b] Act 3 release ETA: Q2 or Q3 2023[/b][/h2]

We will let you know what we will do for the complete release of the game. So far we keep our options as the game quality will improve with the early access. The thing is, we may only have to do the integration then the translation. And of course, we still want to keep some surprises for you. 👀

As a festive gift to our best community, here is the sneak part of the [b]new Act 2 key art[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279200/01a35e8dd18ce8d1bbad99b86f44416ff2c21ef1.png[/img]

We still have a long way to go and we will do our best to release the full game!

We hope everyone has wonderful goals and aspirations for the future as well! Thank you for everything in 2021 and here’s to 2022! 🎉

[b]Happy Holidays and New Year[/b],
the ARISEN Team ❤️

As you know, today is the Steams Awards!  🏆

We are very proud of our journey on ARISEN! Some of you have supported us since our Kickstarter and today we see that more and more people join us on the game.

Although we are on early access, you have met various characters: our sweet Waard as well as the most horrible ones ([strike]hi Gawamel[/strike]). You have been able to explore the beautiful cities of Maccialat and also be in some troubles that are beyond your control!

Day after day, you’ve been helping to make the game better with your feedback and we thank you for that.

That’s why we're counting on you to continue to support the creators in voting ARISEN in the category "story-rich" game! We still have a lot to show you and Act 1 is only the beginning of a great adventure! ✨

Maratus Team ❤️

notes.title: The Act 1 Epilogue is out! ✨
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279200/b10291652ddf11a38e99869b6e6672288bc33170.png[/img]

Hello everyone! 

[i]“Have you received your invitation? From Sujik to Prora’I’Ganda, all Maccials talk about the preparation of the big event. Get ready for the birthday celebration of the heir of the God-King. It is said that slaves who have shown great qualities are set free... “[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279200/6398fd715e47734dc0e920c4e58fea98e5c90e04.png[/img]

Here it’s our first update: the Act 1 Epilogue is now out!
With this first big update, you will be able to play the full First Act of the game, from the start to the end. 

Go back to your favorite playable character, take your courage in both hands, and go to the royal heir’s birthday party… It’s time to Meet the God King Mehve. 

Once you’ve finished the epilogue, you may be really curious to know when the prologue of the second Act shall be released! Don’t worry, we’re working on an updated roadmap to keep you informed on the next steps.

[b]What have we added or fixed recently?[/b]

[list]
[*]Starting from the tarot table, you will be able to launch the Epilogue by clicking on the Mehve’s pendant and unlock the end of the Act 1. Beware, there will be no turning back so be sure to complete everything you want before clicking!
[*]We have also set up achievements: you can now unlock 6 Steam successes in Act 1.
[*]From now on, saves will be shared between computers with the Steam Cloud Save system.
[*]We’ve fixed more than 25+ bugs, dead ends, relationships errors and more quality of life things, so if you want to know more please check our patch note on Steam!
[/list]

If you haven't already done so, don't hesitate to post reviews on Steam and send us your comments and opinions on the first act of the game! 

We can't thank you enough for your support! ❤️

We're still listening to your feedback, please use the bug report tool with the F8 key in game or you can still reach us on our Discord.

notes.title: ARISEN roadmap update
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]💖

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279200/0f2237922b658aca22a2fb2c81e07771d1b571e9.png[/img]

It’s been a while since we last wrote something to you, and for a good reason: a lot of things are happening on our side! We have a lot of topics, bad as well as good, on the agenda today!

First of all, let’s check the roadmap first: we had previously announced a playtesting session in May/June (with the Steam Next Fest demo to end this session). To be honest, we haven’t launched a first playtest session yet. Still, we got plenty of useful feedback on the June demo, so many thanks for your comments!
Of course, we’re still planning to do some playtests sessions: the first sessions should start by the end of summer. More than a hundred of you have signed up for them, which makes us very happy!

You may think, “that’s great but we want to be able to play the full game, not the playtest version. So when will we be able to play ARISEN?” 

[b]We made an important decision for the future of the game[/b], and it was not an easy one. A while back, we asked you on Discord what would you prefer for the release. [b]We finally decided to release the game in Early Access on Steam in the coming weeks[/b] (yes, weeks!). Even if we would have preferred to let you play the whole game from start to the end, the financial realities caught up with us. So we’ve decided to release the game into 3 pieces, Act by Act. It’s allowing us to improve the game step by step between these big releases. 


[h3]Why will you release the game in Early Access?
[/h3]

There are several reasons behind why. Financial reasons on one hand (more than 2 years without any income) and on the other hand, the impact of the covid both on our providers and partners. Of course, our organisation itself suffered from it (almost everyone is working remotely now). There are also internal changes that had to be considered, which we will discuss in a later update. 

[h3]What does this mean for backers? [/h3]

As promised, for those who have a pledge with the beta reward, we will give you access to a beta version of the game (on Steam) during these next weeks. It will include the entire First Act playable, in English and French. This version will evolve through different patches to become the Early Access version. Then, we will add Act 2 or 3 later on, at no extra cost for all those who already have a key to the game (from Kickstarter or purchase on Steam). 

For those who have a pledge with the game, we’ll send you a Steam key as soon as Early Access will be released. 

[h3]What is the current state of the game’s development?[/h3]

All the textual and visual content for the Act 1 is done. Concerning the Act 2, the script is currently being translated and the art content is almost completed. About the Act 3, the story script is almost finished while the art team is about to finish the last backgrounds and remaining characters. 

The team is busy focusing on testing and integrating all the systems in ARISEN. Since we want the game to be like a gamebook, we want it to be as non-linear as possible. These game’s systems are crucial in providing the sense of freedom we want. It’s where we still have so much work to do, and that’s what we will focus on during the early access. 

[h3]What’s next?[/h3]

We’ll keep you updated on the next big steps (such as the early access release date). Meanwhile, please remember to fill your crowdox information, especially as we will need your emails to send your Steam keys soon! Of course if you have to change your address, it should be possible to change it. 

Of course, thank you for your support and patience! 

Before leaving you, here’s a little preview, a first image of the launch trailer we’re working on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279200/103cc18cadebd7220d75d7162fcbf012cd48b3ae.png[/img]

The Maratus team.

notes.title: State of production: ARISEN playtest schedule & roadmap
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

It’s been a while since we didn’t talk here. But it’s because we have a lot coming in the next few weeks! So let’s see together what’s on the menu in today's update? A piece of big news to share and more info about our playtest & release schedule.

First of all, we want to wish to congratulate Anaïs, our narrative designer and her husband Davy. They just started a new book to write. Can't wait to see what kind of cards he will play!
Much love from all the team!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279200/d6409e45937f889f7ea68bbf0516731210df2429.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279200/6543d4832fdf9336c977f4e24d0de9c77fab0097.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Playtesting ARISEN and game roadmap[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279200/ca289baa2851772870981b055b05ed4f6908be9f.jpg[/img]

As promised it’s now the time to talk about our plan to release the game. 

For now, the production is going well. As we said before, our partners are working on the English version of the first Act and we have completed the integration of the second Act in the game. About the second Act, the proofread is almost complete for the french version and we are getting ready to send it to the translation team. 

But as we progress through the production we feel that we were way too optimistic for the release date previously announced.
As you know the covid crisis impacted many things: our partners, the rising fees to ship goodies in Europe and it also affected us and the new way we had to work together.

But if everything continues at this rhythm, well, the game should be ready for a release Q3 2021. Apologies for the wait!

So basically, here is our new roadmap:
[list]
 [*] In May we will start playtesting the first act of the game with the two main languages, French & English, we will unveil more just below! 
[*] Depending on how everything goes, we believe that we could start the first beta version during Q2/summer (July or August).  
[*] If everything checks the green box, we will launch the game Q3 2021. 
[/list]
Please keep in mind that our roadmap is subject to change. You may believe that's bad news, but remember that may be more time for us to add & polish more content in the game. Of course, we hope that you will love what we have in store for the game.

So let’s see what we plan for the playtest: 

[h1]About our playtest plans[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279200/27b4669eb597e95ba4c26dae5ecc6271dc7d47aa.png[/img]

If you're interested in being involved in the alpha playtest, fill in the form here: 

[list][*][b][url=http://bit.ly/ARISENplaytest]http://bit.ly/ARISENplaytest[/url][/b][/list]

Please note you won’t be given a beta version or demo of the game with this survey at this stage. Its purpose is to run a playtest in order to gather specific information such as bugs, proofreading, missing choices or branch, etc. Registration does not guarantee a slot in the playtest group. For backers with beta pledge, rest assured we will give you access to the beta when it will be available, as promised.

For the first playtest, you will test a quest with Igweneil as master. So the build will contain heavy spoilers, some bugs (hopefully not too much), a blocked path and more weird things. To experience a better and clean version, wait for the beta or the release! ; ) 

If you’re selected for the playtest you will receive an email with more details and info.
You will need a Steam account.

To support us you can wishlist the game here!

Thank you!
See you soon!
The Maratus team

notes.title: Woo hoo 50%! Half the Kickstarter campaign done! 🥳🎉🎉
notes.content:
[b]Hello travelers[/b],

We just wanted to share an update about our Kickstarter campaign: [b]we reached the 50% goal![/b]🎉 It’s awesome and we want to [b]thank you all for your support[/b]. 🙏

We still have more than 2 weeks to go, so we hope we can count on your support for the next 50% or less to succeed in the campaign.

If you miss the latest update on the Kickstarter page, we revealed more about our Cards mechanics. As you know ARISEN is a narrative card game with a strong focus on [b]Emotions[/b].💖

Soon in the development, we had the idea to use [b]5 “family”[/b] of emotions and we were thinking about ways to do it in-game.

That’s at this moment while brainstorming we thought about cards; it seemed a good way to represent emotions and add some cool gameplay twists with the possibility to unlock and collect a new one. Plus, we love how some games used this idea, such as in [i]Dragon Age: Inquisition[/i] from [i]BioWare[/i].

So while playing you will unlock 3 kinds of cards: first, the [b]Emotion cards[/b], then the [b]Character cards[/b] and last but not least the [b]Feeling cards[/b]. Every kind of card will serve a specific use.

You will find more about the topic on our 3 Kickstarter updates here: 

[list]
[*]Update #3: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/maratus/arisen-a-narrative-card-game/posts/2961233]How emotions, narrative game and cards work together 💖🃏📘 [/url]

[*]Update #5: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/maratus/arisen-a-narrative-card-game/posts/2965634]What’s the purpose of characters cards and feelings cards? 💖[/url]
[/list]

Let us know what you think and share with us what topic you want to read next! 
The Maratus Team.

notes.title: Dev's News #2
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35279200/5a8f0ba714b5dab518b278a19d09f145f68a8f47.png[/img]

Hello traveller,

Nice of you to pay me a visit. Have a seat. You came to me for news, didn’t you? You want to know more about ARISEN… What can I tell you?

[h1]GAMESCOM[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35279200/15e9af12df86b4a2cb5b5966bdd61304470768c3.jpg[/img]

The fellowship of Maratus met a lot of people in Köln! Warriors, mages, bards, druids… It was an exhausting yet terrifying journey. The feedbacks about the demo were excellent. Elene, Sylvain and Anaïs were pleased to be introduced to new, interesting, crazy people in the taverns of Köln.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35279200/b9642490b06b89feb13883c170569fa9a743e2e6.jpg[/img]

Elene is on the left, Sylvain is on the middle, and Anaïs on the right. They seem harmless but they are mischevious creatures, so… Be prepared!

[h1]KODA’S FACIAL EXPRESSIONS[/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/YO9zGr9rnblQPPZUeK/giphy.gif[/img]

Now Koda is able to show you his feelings. Joy, fear, disgust, anger… Will appear on his face. He can be rude sometimes… But if he trusts you, he will be the sweetest man ever, dear. 

[h1]ANOTHER VIEW OF THE GLOBAL MAP[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279200/404ba6c695178e4488b2ab00cb07b2f82e36cd80.png[/img]

Here is the south east of Var’Nagal. In Woshuxi you’ll find nomadic clans of humans and orcs. They’re kept under surveillance by the winged halflings and suspicious gnomes living in the closed mountains...

Thank you for listening to an old crazy lady, traveller. We’ll meet again I promise: then I will tell you more about ARISEN, Var’Nagal and the fellowship of MARATUS...

Have a nice day,
[i]Sage Zorah[/i]
